Free astrology calculators

Instant, real calculations for the ones that don't need a full birth chart — and an honest note on the ones that do.

Instant calculators

Love Calculator
The classic name-based love-percentage calculator — enter two names and see your score.
For entertainment — a fun, deterministic formula, not a professional compatibility reading. For real compatibility guidance, talk to an astrologer.
Flames Calculator
The classic F-L-A-M-E-S elimination game — Friends, Love, Affection, Marriage, Enemies, Siblings.
For entertainment only.
Friendship Calculator
A different name-based formula focused on friendship compatibility, not romance.
For entertainment only.
Name Compatibility Calculator
Uses Chaldean name-numerology to compare the hidden numeric value of two names.
Chaldean numerology, a classic alternate numbering system to Pythagorean numerology. For entertainment only.
Numerology Calculator
Your Life Path Number — the core number in numerology, calculated from your date of birth.
Lo Shu Grid Calculator
Places the digits of your date of birth onto the classic 3×3 Lo Shu magic square.
Sun Sign Calculator
Your Western zodiac sign — exact, from your date of birth alone.
Moon Phase Calculator
The Moon's phase and illumination on any date, computed astronomically.
Lucky Vehicle Number Calculator
Numerology-friendly digits for your vehicle registration, based on your Life Path Number.
Rising Sign (Ascendant) Calculator
Your Ascendant — genuinely computed from your exact birth date, time and place, not a canned lookup.
Uses your exact birth time, so the result is only as accurate as the time you enter — even a few minutes' difference can shift the Ascendant.
Rashi (Moon Sign) Calculator
Your Vedic Moon sign, from your date and approximate time of birth.
Approximate: the Moon changes sign roughly every 2¼ days, so this uses a simplified lunar-position formula (not a full ephemeris). If your birth time is near a sign change, confirm with an astrologer.
Nakshatra Calculator
Your birth star (Nakshatra) and pada, from your date and time of birth.
Approximate, same simplified lunar formula as the Rashi calculator — treat a result near a boundary as indicative, not final.

Needs a full birth chart

These need the precise position of every planet at the moment you were born — Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Rahu and Ketu — computed from a professional ephemeris. Getting any one of them wrong by even a degree can flip the reading, so rather than show you an approximate number that might be wrong, Astrowani's verified astrologers calculate these precisely with proper astrology software during a live consultation.
